rows.note: Use this for a decorative object or item added to make something more attractive.

example.english: That decoration on the living-room cabinet is really pretty.
example.traditional: 客廳個櫃嗰件裝飾品真係幾靚。
example.jyutping: haak3 teng1 go3 gwai6 go2 gin6 zong1 sik1 ban2 zan1 hai6 gei2 leng3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for decoration as ornamentation or the overall act and effect of adorning something.

example.english: During Chinese New Year, the decoration at home is simple but creates a lovely atmosphere.
example.traditional: 新年期間，屋企嘅裝飾簡單，但好有氣氛。
example.jyutping: san1 nin4 kei4 gaan1 uk1 kei2 ge3 zong1 sik1 gaan2 daan1 daan6 hou2 jau5 hei3 fan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a medal or order worn as an official mark of honour.

example.english: They wore that medal as a decoration on their suit.
example.traditional: 佢將嗰枚勳章戴咗喺件西裝上面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 go2 mui4 fan1 zoeng1 daai3 zo2 hai2 gin6 sai1 zong1 soeng6 min6
